findings.editChain: edit→save→reopen→public→update→intact: YES — t-field writes to the MODEL record (save_embedded_field calls record.write()), NOT to the view arch; module update (-u piqueray_ds) reloads the arch from XML (which still contains t-field directives pointing to the same model fields) and renders the current database values; data is never touched by the update
findings.inlineEditing: YES — core_setup_editor_plugin makes all [data-oe-model] elements contenteditable; save_plugin includes [data-oe-field] in savable_selectors; text fields round-trip via value_to_html (nl2br) and from_html (html_to_text); rich-text marks are NOT available (plain text only) which matches the verdict (allowedMarks: [])

verdict: CONFIRMED — t-field on Text fields of the website model is the correct mechanism. Data persists in the database, survives module updates, supports inline editing in the website editor, and round-trips plain text with line breaks correctly. No verdict change needed.

additionalFindings.footerXpath: All native Odoo 19 footer templates use xpath expr='//div[@id="footer"]' position='replace' on website.layout. The base structure is <footer id='bottom'><div id='footer'/></footer>. The default active footer is 'footer_custom'. Our template must deactivate it and activate ours — same pattern as the header.
